_comment: Art prompts for No. 19, written 2026-10-19 and NOT generated: Higgsfield's Private workspace had 0.25 credits, no credit-reset offer, and the unlimited allowance does not cover recraft-v4-1 (and was not active). Run each through generate_image (model recraft-v4-1, model_type standard, colors [#171512,#F3E8D2,#7FAEA3,#A94A34], background_color #F3E8D2) once the account has credits, optimize with scripts/optimize-image.sh <in> public/assets/spots/<file> 900 88, check each at 120 px, then set story.image and layout (feature imageTop, the rest alternating imageLeft/imageRight) and the scanner images, which currently point at the possum placeholder.
